turns.assessment: The evidence does not establish an optical-network fault. trx.och188.a shows no change in rx_power or any companion receiver metric, while upstream OCMs, amplifiers, and the far-end interface also show no change. A card failure could make local monitoring invalid, but it should also interrupt traffic in both directions and affect the far-end receiver; that corroboration is absent. A telemetry/reporting freeze or simply a stable measurement is more likely, but neither is a documented equipment fault mode in the case.

proposals.rationale: This is the only documented mode that can invalidate monitoring at this receiver. It is strongly disfavoured because the far-end receiver and all optical-path instruments remained unchanged, with no signal-loss, unit-down, or service evidence.
